name: [WARRIOR] Noob Arena
desc:
👋Noob Arena👋

Go around fighting other players as a noob class! This is meant to be a more action based, but fun multiplayer game! Unlock different skins as you progress!

Assets are borrowed from toolbox

Have Fun in this FFA Game!

🖥️PC CONTROLS🖥️ 
Q - Dash
F- Block
Skill 1 - One(Default)
Skill 2 - Two(Default)
Skill 3 - Three(Default)
M - Menu(Go back to spawn)

YOU GET CASH IN THIS GAME BY EACH KILL! 

Join the group for 2x Coins per kill!

This game is a SOLO project underneath my group

Thanks for Playing!
